knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A machine is isolated and stopped before any blockage is cleared. Working on a running machine is never acceptable.
A blunt blade is replaced. Forcing a tool causes slips, and sharpening on the spot is not the register's control.
A nozzle that is not fully connected can whip or release a jet, so it is not operated until the connection is complete.

practicalCriteria: Inspects a named machine's guard, cord, pads, hose and emergency stop before use, and records the result
Keeps the hand behind the blade when using a scraper, and replaces a blunt blade
Switches off and isolates a machine before clearing a simulated blockage
Labels and withdraws a simulated defective machine and reports it
passRule: Knowledge checks are a reading check only and are not verified practical competence. Assessor must observe every practical criterion; any failure requires remediation and reassessment.
stopWorkCriteria: A guard or emergency stop is removed or bypassed
A machine is reached into while running
A pressure nozzle or hose is operated while not fully connected
